description: Checks whether a domain name looks available and quotes a price. Quote only: deed.page does not sell domains yet, and nothing is bought or reserved. Inputs: name (a label such as mybrand, or a full name such as mybrand.com) and optional tlds (comma list such as com,dev,app; at most 10). Returns one row per extension with status (available, taken, or unknown), and for non-taken names a quote: first-year and renewal price in USD, each the registrar's cost x 1.10 rounded up to the next cent, with the cost shown. Availability and price are confirmed at purchase; premium names can cost more. Domain registration is coming soon: the result carries a waitlist email.

name.description: Domain label or full name, for example mybrand or mybrand.com.

tlds.description: Comma list of extensions, for example com,dev,app. Default com,net,org,dev,app,io. At most 10.

name: search_domains
title: Search and quote domains
